vars.objective: Turn the salvagers' winches on the north spoke (the Chainyard) and the south spoke (the wreck of the Gilded Psalm).
journal: The day before the Kindling. The Hierophant himself is coming to Lanternfall. Mom read my letters.
I woke up. Fennick says it's been a year. He says there are no days anymore. He made me eat soup.
Fennick built cairns for Mom and Dad. He was Dad's friend — "Fen." He's the one who left books on my step, every month, for eleven years. He gave me a sword.
A kite-courier named Linnet says there's a Mender girl running a hospital in the ruins of Aurenne. Ilse. She's alive. Folk blame "the Keeper's daughter." Fennick told Linnet my name is Lark.
The Ashmaw — Fennick's chicken-thief — attacked on the bridge. I fought it alone. I won. Fennick said, "There she is."
Keelhaven: a town made of upturned boats. There's a notice on the gate about "the Keeper's daughter," with a noose drawn under it. I told them my name is Lark.
Maela and Pell are alive, in Keelhaven. Tobias got eleven people to safety, then went back out for more and never came back. Maela called me Lark without even blinking.
Warden Hale says a sky-serpent called the Unmoored blocks the old strait. Two winches lower the bridge across. I said I'd go. Alone. I'm used to alone.
Brother Cinder almost had me, at the east gate. Maela told the whole crowd I was Lark Tobiasdaughter. She lied for me. She said, "Just come back."

c6_pell_kite.title: Pell's Kite
c6_pell_kite.desc: Pell wants to fly a message-kite with the names of the lost painted on it. He needs Choir silk — from the banners of the wrecked Gilded Psalm on the south spoke of the Shattered Sea.

c6_letters.title: The Lost Wall
c6_letters.desc: Orla keeps a wall of letters for the missing in Keelhaven. Lost letters drift in the wreckage of the Drift and the Shattered Sea — bring any you find to her.

c6_bounty_glass.title: Bounty: Glassback
c6_bounty_glass.desc: A golem of living glass has been wrecking the salvagers' quarry, west of the north spoke of the Shattered Sea. Defeat it and bring proof to Warden Hale.

c6_bounty_lidless.title: Bounty: The Lidless
c6_bounty_lidless.desc: Something with too many eyes has made a perch north of the Last Hearth, past the strait bridge. Defeat it and bring proof to Warden Hale.
